rows.ru: Однажды я работал рядом с этим домом.
rows.en: One day I was working near this house.
This part of the city is very big.
There are always a lot of cars there.

rows.ru: Примерно час я стоял у двери.
rows.en: I stood by the door for about an hour.

rows.ru: Ждать до конца я не мог.
rows.en: I couldn't wait until the end.
I start work very early.
Some people only turn up an hour later.

rows.ru: Так у меня есть возможность думать о работе.
rows.en: That way I get a chance to think about the work.

rows.ru: Я считаю, что это очень хорошо.
rows.en: I think that is a very good thing.

rows.ru: Но не каждый может работать так рано.
rows.en: But not everyone can work that early.
Our company has its own system.

rows.ru: Приходится выходить из дома очень рано.
rows.en: You have to leave the house very early.

rows.ru: Работать таким образом могут не все.
rows.en: Not everyone can work that way.

rows.ru: Но именно поэтому мы всё делаем быстро.
rows.en: But that is exactly why we get everything done quickly.

rows.ru: Также у нас есть время для семьи.
rows.en: We also have time for our families.

rows.ru: Он вообще не отвечает на мои вопросы.
rows.en: He doesn't answer my questions at all.

rows.ru: Хотя я знаю, что он всё слышит.
rows.en: Even though I know he hears everything.

rows.ru: У него такое отношение к работе.
rows.en: That is his attitude to work.
Nothing can help him.
He is a good man, though, of course.

rows.ru: Каждый день приходится решать новые задачи.
rows.en: Every day there are new problems to solve.
Sometimes that becomes a real problem.

rows.ru: Но я решаю почти всё сам.
rows.en: But I decide almost everything myself.

rows.ru: Конечно, некоторые вопросы решает мой друг.
rows.en: Of course, my friend handles some of the questions.
That is how a person keeps getting better.
One day the police found an illegal agreement.
By law you cannot do that.

rows.ru: Преступник говорил, что ничего не знает.
rows.en: The criminal kept saying he knew nothing.

rows.ru: Но для полиции закон есть закон.
rows.en: But for the police the law is the law.
In the end there will be a trial.
This is a murder case.

rows.ru: Преступление произошло рядом с нашим городом.
rows.en: The crime happened near our city.
The judge spoke about this crime.
The guilty man already knows his punishment.
Prison is waiting for him.
A thief used to live in our building.
He took money from the shop.
The police quickly found a witness.
The arrest was yesterday.

rows.ru: Женщина из магазина будет свидетельствовать в суде.
rows.en: The woman from the shop is going to testify in court.
This man was stealing money.
The police found all the proof.
His testimony helped the police.

rows.ru: Судить его будут в этом году.
rows.en: He will be tried this year.
The contract was criminal too.
Yesterday I was reading a new detective novel.

rows.ru: В книге были вор и уголовное дело.
rows.en: There was a thief and a criminal case in the book.
The police could not find the killer.
Somebody tried to give the lawyer a bribe.
I really love books like that.

rows.ru: Рядом с нашим домом есть большой храм.
rows.en: There is a big church near our house.

rows.ru: Однажды там была свадьба моего друга.
rows.en: My friend's wedding was held there once.
There are many icons in the church.
Some people come to the church to pray.

rows.ru: Хотя я не религиозный человек, мне там хорошо.
rows.en: Although I am not a religious man, I feel good there.

rows.ru: Завтра пасха, и все идут в храм.
rows.en: Tomorrow is Easter, and everyone is going to church.
It is the most important Christian day.
Mum reads the Bible every day.

rows.ru: Без веры она жить не может.
rows.en: She could not live without her faith.

rows.ru: На той иконе ангел, а рядом распятие.
rows.en: There is an angel on that icon, and a crucifix beside it.

rows.ru: Моя мама постоянно говорит о боге.
rows.en: My mother talks about God all the time.

rows.ru: Она считает, что вера — это доверие.
rows.en: She thinks that faith means trust.
Every person has their sins.

rows.ru: Дьявол и грех — это одно и то же.
rows.en: The devil and sin are one and the same thing.

rows.ru: Господь всё видит и всё знает.
rows.en: The Lord sees everything and knows everything.
